## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install house_pricing_nbdev in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure house_pricing_nbdev package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to house_pricing_nbdev
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/IshmaelAsab/house_pricing_nbdev):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/IshmaelAsab/house_pricing_nbdev.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/IshmaelAsab/house_pricing_nbdev)

``` sh
$ conda install -c IshmaelAsab house_pricing_nbdev
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/house_pricing_nbdev/)

``` sh
$ pip install house_pricing_nbdev
```
